reflection one of the nicest gifts one can give to another person is the gift of encouragement. and it costs nothing. plant words of encouragement everywhere you go today and just watch what happens. have you ever noticed how someone with shoulders bent, head drooped and eyes dull from disillusionment, pain or discouragement, will react when given a few kind words of encouragement? flatter me, and i may not believe you. criticise me and i may not like you. encourage me and i will not forget you. encouragement and words of kindness are gifts you can give that are priceless. pause for a moment and think of one practical way you can encourage someone today. wherever you go always leave a legacy of encouragement after you. bank holiday. as monday is a bank holiday the parish ofïce will be closed, and the church will close after the morning mass and rosary. altar list of the dead. 2025-26. the new altar list of the dead is being complied at the moment. please return your competed lists to the church. thank you to all those who helped in their delivery. spare envelopes and lists are on the tables around the church. the first mass for the new llst will be offered on all souls day, november 2nd, and every first friday in the months ahead. feast of saints simon a nd jude. 24th/25th october 2 026
